newsitem.title: CHINA: AXA-UAP opens fourth China office.
newsitem.headline: AXA-UAP opens fourth China office.

text.p: French insurer AXA UAP has opened its fourth office in China in the industrial city of Wuhan, capital of central Hubei province, the Xinhua news agency said on Thursday.
AXA UAP first set up a representative office in China in 1989 and already has offices in Beijing, Shanghai and the southern city of Guangzhou.
It plans to open another office in western China, Xinhua said.
Scores of foreign insurance firms have opened representative offices in China but only a handful are allowed to issue policies.
Those firms include Winterthur Swiss Insurance Co, American International Assurance Co Ltd, a part of the American International Group, and Tokio Marine & Fire Insurance Co Ltd.
